chapter: The Cantankerous Fish Have Their Circumstances?
act_title: The Cantankerous Fish Have Their Circumstances?

quests.title: The Cantankerous Fish Have Their Circumstances?

dialogue.t: Thank you for all your hard work, {NICKNAME} and Paimon.
I have a pretty good understanding of our patients' condition now, so I've mixed them up some special Melusine medicine...
Adding these herbs to the water tank should help calm them down.
So you're basically turning the whole tank into a giant health spa?
That really is a plan that only you could pull off, Sigewinne!

dialogue.sit: But won't this only temporarily relieve their symptoms?
To completely cure them, we still need to find the root cause...

dialogue.t: You're spot on. I'll need to invite a whole variety of different fish here for physical examinations before I can determine exactly what's wrong.
I'll put together a list of patients to check based on the characteristics I need.
I'd appreciate it if you could keep a close eye out for any fish that meet the criteria.

quests.description: Sigewinne seems to have something to tell us…
